scope: Custom — today's 8:20 PM ET game only

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games before the historical cutoff.

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

model_version: V7.2.8 PRICE-TARGET CORE with explicit user-directed 15P override

methodology.alternate_hr: Count locked Stage 1 L10 observations greater than or equal to each alternate threshold; denominator remains 10.
methodology.core_tiebreak: When equally close to -250, select the more negative price.
methodology.floor: Immediately lower available threshold than CORE.
methodology.ceiling: Immediately higher available threshold than CORE.
methodology.candidate_narrowing: Carry only candidates with a qualifying CORE, an available FLOOR, and FLOOR historical HR >=7/10, the minimum portfolio-leg HR requirement.
methodology.user_percentile_override: 15P remains the independently locked 20-game percentile from Stage 1; it does not alter historical HR or alternate-line hit rates.

stage1_qualification.rule: Market HR >=6/10 OR at least one fixed ladder >=8/10

band_selection.core_rule: FanDuel over odds between -350 and -150 inclusive; choose price closest to -250; tie-break to more negative odds.
band_selection.floor_rule: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
band_selection.ceiling_rule: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE.

stage3_candidate.rationale: Carried forward: qualifying CORE and adjacent FLOOR available; FLOOR historical HR meets or exceeds 7/10.
stage3_candidate.selection_basis: CORE available; FLOOR exists; FLOOR historical HR >=7/10. No current-week context used.
